shortDefinition.en: Fujifilm's color-sampling arrangement with a repeating 6 × 6 filter pattern.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 富士采用的一种以 6 × 6 滤色区块重复的彩色采样排列。

en: X-Trans is a filter arrangement used with CMOS sensors, not a competing base sensor technology.
zh-cn: X-Trans 是用于 CMOS 传感器的滤色排列，不是与其竞争的基础传感器技术。

example.en: The official X-T5 specification names an X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 官方规格将其传感器命名为 X-Trans CMOS 5 HR。

en: Each filtered sample supplies one color component; reconstruction estimates other components. X-Trans and conventional Bayer differ in spatial arrangement. Do not infer that every Fujifilm camera uses X-Trans, or that a filter pattern alone guarantees a particular final look.
zh-cn: 每个滤色采样点提供一个颜色分量，重建过程据此估计其他分量。X-Trans 与常见 Bayer 的区别在空间排列。不能据此认为所有富士相机都使用 X-Trans，也不能认为排列本身保证最终风格。
